meta.name: business-growth-skills
meta.description: Router/index for the 4 business & growth skills bundled in this plugin: customer-success-manager (health scoring, churn risk, expansion), sales-engineer (RFP analysis, competitive matrices, PoC planning), revenue-operations (pipeline, forecast accuracy, GTM efficiency), and contract-and-proposal-writer. Use when a growth/revenue request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'which accounts are at risk', 'should we bid on this RFP').

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据增长需求自动分配合适的业务技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理客户健康度、RFP分析或收入预测等增长任务
copy.tagline_en: Route growth requests to the right business skill automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle tasks like health scoring, RFP analysis, or pipeline forecasting

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先判断你的请求属于哪个业务技能(客户成功、销售工程、营收运营、合同提案),再加载对应技能流程执行;若同时匹配多个,会先问一个问题澄清。
howto.when: 当你的请求是增长或营收相关,但又不能明显归入某个具体技能时触发,例如询问“哪些账户有风险”或“该不该竞标这份RFP”。

say.text: 哪些客户有流失风险?帮我看一下
say.note: 会路由到客户成功技能进行健康评分

say.text: 分析这份RFP,我们该投标吗?
say.note: 会路由到销售工程师技能做覆盖分析

say.text: 检查一下销售管道覆盖率和预测准确度
say.note: 会路由到营收运营技能

howto.what_en: After install, Claude routes your request to one of 4 business skills (customer success, sales engineering, revenue ops, contract writing), loads that skill's workflow, and asks a clarifying question if multiple match.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a growth/revenue request doesn't clearly match one specific skill, e.g., 'which accounts are at risk' or 'should we bid on this RFP'.

say_en.text: Which customers are at risk of churn? Take a look.
say_en.note: Routes to the customer-success skill for health scoring.

say_en.text: Analyze this RFP — should we bid?
say_en.note: Routes to the sales-engineer skill for coverage analysis.

say_en.text: Check our pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.
